note: Aquatic Comic series (3 Nov 2026): 59 humor tees in six subsets, dark palette only. Left chest: DS mark (white D + red S) centred over the slogan, IM Fell English Italic; back: the joke, IM Fell English Roman, 11 in block. White ink + PMS 485 C red punch words at 125%. {N} = one name; {A}/{B} = buddy pair; {H}/{W} = husband / wife. *word* = red.

S.name: Boat Banter
S.blurb: Twenty one-liners from the dive deck. No names, just the joke.

W.name: Self-Logged
W.blurb: Your name, your habits, your logbook. Worn by the diver it is about.
W.label: Your name

R.name: Buddy Check
R.blurb: Your dive buddy’s name and the story they’d rather you didn’t tell. Made to give.
R.label: Buddy’s name

B.name: Buddy System
B.blurb: Two names, one dive, two versions of what happened. Made as a matching pair.
B.label: Diver 1 / Diver 2

C.name: Till Surface Do Us Part
C.blurb: For the husband-and-wife dive team. Both names, a matching pair.
C.label: Husband / Wife

M.name: Master Class
M.blurb: For the couple who both carry a Master Scuba Diver card, and still argue about the mask.
M.label: Husband / Wife

designs.name: Nitrogen
designs.back:
At 100 feet my buddy gave a heartfelt thumbs-up to a rock.
Just a *rock*.
He’s told the story at three dinner parties since.

designs.name: Current
designs.front:
Plan the dive.
Dive the plan.
Blame the *current*.
designs.back:
The briefing said mild current.
The current *didn’t* attend the briefing.

designs.name: Dry Suit
designs.back:
My jokes don’t land.
Neither does my *descent*.
We’re working on both.

designs.name: Visibility
designs.front:
Visibility is a mood,
*not* a measurement.
designs.back:
The shop promised 80 feet of vis.
I could see my hand.
I’m logging it as 80 feet of *trust*.

designs.name: Buoyancy
designs.back:
I can hover motionless at 15 feet for five minutes.
I *cannot stay quiet* about your fin kick for five seconds.

designs.name: Brag
designs.back:
My safety stop takes three minutes.
My retelling of the dive takes *forty-five*.

designs.name: Snacks
designs.back:
Saw a turtle, a reef shark, and an eagle ray on one dive.
The boat had those little *orange crackers*.
Guess what I talked about on the ride home.

designs.name: Low on Air
designs.back:
500 psi and a smile is how I surface.
500 psi and a *lecture* is how I get back on the boat.

designs.name: Surface Interval
designs.front:
Surface interval
is a *state of mind*.
designs.back:
Technically I’m off-gassing.
Spiritually I’m back in the water.
Physically I’m eating a *sandwich*.

designs.name: Gas Management
designs.back:
My therapist asked what makes me feel in control.
I said checking my SPG every two minutes.
She *wrote something down*.

designs.name: Equalizing
designs.back:
Sat through a two-hour meeting pinching my nose.
Nobody asked.
That was *worse*.

designs.name: Hover
designs.front:
Buoyancy:
the art of trying
*not* to try.
designs.back:
Spent two weeks perfecting my hover.
Lost it the second a lobster made *eye contact*.

designs.name: Good Dive
designs.back:
Some are just better stories.
Lost a fin, found it.
Lost my buddy, found him.
Lost my dignity. *Still looking*.

designs.name: Salt
designs.front:
Salt in my hair,
*nitrogen* in my tissues.
designs.back:
My skin says beach vacation.
My dive computer says *sit still*.

designs.name: Mask On
designs.back:
No email at 60 feet.
The only notification is a *parrotfish* crunching coral.

designs.name: Born to Dive
designs.back:
I check the weather at work.
Not for the commute.
For the *vis*.

designs.name: Dive More
designs.back:
My boss asked where I see myself in five years.
Sixty feet down, hovering, was *not the answer* he wanted.

designs.name: Weight Belt
designs.back:
Overweighted on dive one.
Underweighted on dive two.
Dive three was mostly *stories*.

designs.name: Fins First
designs.back:
Nailed the giant stride.
The camera watched from the *bench*.

designs.name: Bubbles
designs.back:
Left my worries at 60 feet.
Brought home a *sunburn* instead.

designs.name: Camel
designs.back:
Everyone surfaced at 500 psi.
{N} surfaced at *1800*.
Nobody trusts {N} anymore.

designs.name: Trim
designs.back:
{N} can hold a safety stop without moving a fin.
The punchlines are *another story*.

designs.name: Snacks
designs.back:
Two tanks, one turtle, zero memory of either.
{N} can describe every *cookie* on the boat.

designs.name: Equalizing
designs.back:
Everyone else hit the bottom.
{N} was at 10 feet, pinching.
{N} calls it a *graceful* descent.

designs.name: Weight
designs.back:
Two extra pounds on the belt.
Three extra stories at the bar.
{N} is *negatively buoyant* either way.

designs.name: Nitrox
designs.back:
Thirty-two percent oxygen.
One hundred percent *opinions*.
Ask {N} about MOD. Actually, *don’t*.

designs.name: Fins
designs.back:
The left one is my brother Daryl.
The right one is my other brother *Daryl*.
{N} insists this is normal.

designs.name: Wetsuit
designs.back:
Getting in took ten minutes.
Getting out took twenty.
The wetsuit leads the series, *3 to 1*.

designs.name: Retired
designs.back:
Used to check stock prices every morning.
Now {N} checks the tide chart.
Returns have *improved*.

designs.name: One More
designs.back:
{N} said that at dive 50.
And dive 100.
*Nobody believes* {N} at the dock anymore.

designs.name: Shark
designs.back:
It was a nurse shark.
It was asleep.
{N} still calls it a *great white*.

designs.name: Vacuum
designs.back:
The group turned at half a tank.
{N} turned at a quarter.
The boat crew calls {N} *the vacuum*.

designs.name: Navigator
designs.back:
{N} led the dive back to the anchor line.
It was a *different boat’s* anchor line.

designs.name: Photographer
designs.back:
A manta swam right past the group.
{N} was photographing a *nudibranch*.
The manta was not mentioned again.

designs.name: Briefing
designs.front:
{N} was at the briefing.
Mentally, *at lunch*.
designs.back:
Asked what the max depth was.
On the descent.
*By slate*.

designs.name: Logbook
designs.back:
Max depth: deep.
Visibility: yes.
Marine life: *a whole fish, maybe two*.

designs.name: Night Dive
designs.back:
Pointed the torch at a squid.
The squid pointed *back*.
{N} hasn’t mentioned it since.

designs.name: Slate
designs.back:
{N} brought a slate
to say the octopus was cool.
*Underlined twice*.

designs.name: Computer
designs.back:
Beeped on ascent.
Beeped at the safety stop.
Beeped at {N} in the *parking lot*, just in case.

designs.name: Ladder
designs.back:
First off the boat.
Last back on.
{N} treats the ladder as *a suggestion*.

designs.name: Stories
designs.back:
{A} saw a shark.
{B} saw a big grouper.
The video shows a *medium* grouper.

designs.name: The Plan
designs.back:
The plan was perfect.
The current didn’t *read it*.
*{B}* said so the whole ride home.

designs.name: If Lost
designs.back:
{A} looked away for one second.
{B} was gone.
Found later at the *snack table*.

designs.name: Air & Snacks
designs.back:
One of them gets you home.
The other makes it worth it.
*Nobody’s* saying which.

designs.name: Slow & Fast
designs.back:
One tank lasts {A} an hour.
{B} needs a tank *just for the story* afterward.

designs.name: Navigation
designs.back:
{A} navigated by compass.
{B} navigated by *vibes*.
Both found the anchor line. Eventually.

designs.name: Since Day One
designs.back:
{A} forgot a fin.
{B} forgot a mask.
They’ve been *inseparable* since.

designs.name: Hand Signals
designs.back:
Three hand signals to learn.
{B} invented *a fourth*.
It means “is there lunch on the boat.”

designs.name: Photos
designs.back:
{B} took 400 photos.
{A} is in 380 of them.
Mostly as a *blurry fin*.

designs.name: Sharing
designs.back:
Shared a tank on the training dive.
Shared a cabin on the liveaboard.
Still *not* sharing the *snacks*.

designs.name: Vows
designs.back:
Vowed to stay together in sickness and in health.
Underwater, within arm’s reach.
Topside, within *snack* reach.

designs.name: Navigator
designs.back:
{H} swore the anchor line was north.
{W} swam them straight to it.
{H} calls it *teamwork*.

designs.name: Octo
designs.back:
Years of marriage.
She still lets him breathe off her octo.
That’s *love*.

designs.name: Hand Signals
designs.front:
Married divers.
We argue in
*hand signals*.
designs.back:
{H} signals OK.
{W} signals *we’ll talk about this* on the boat.

designs.name: Honeymoon
designs.back:
Some couples went to Paris.
We went to 60 feet.
Better view, and nobody *talked*.

designs.name: Photographer
designs.back:
Three hundred photos of a seahorse.
One photo of {H}.
*It’s blurry*.

designs.name: Master Arguers
designs.back:
Two Master Scuba Diver cards.
Ten specialties between them.
Still can’t agree *who packed the mask*.

designs.name: Master Packers
designs.back:
{H} handles the gas plan.
{W} handles the dive plan.
*Both* handle the cooler.

designs.name: One Master
designs.front:
{H} & {W}.
Two Master Scuba Divers.
*One read the manual*.
designs.back:
One of us read the manual.
One of us read the dive computer.
*Together*, one master diver.
